-- Step 7: As-of readings: what a diligent verifier knew, then and now -----
  as-of 2027-01-15: reading evidentiary; freshness fresh; coverage 0/0; trust
               log-anchored; outcome PASS
    evidence: as-of prefix contains 2 events, 0 recalls; the campaign of
               2027-06-15 is invisible to it
  as-of 2027-07-01: reading current-state; freshness fresh; coverage 0/3; trust
               log-anchored; outcome DEGRADED (signatures-framed-only)
    evidence: as-of prefix contains 4 events, 1 recall; replayed safety
               flag recall-active; multi-suite framing degrades explicitly
               rather than passing
  note:       Law needs all three readings: the evidentiary reading
               protects good-faith actors who verified before the campaign,
               the current-state reading carries the recall forward, and the
               cryptographic reading certifies the chain itself (I9).
